LanguageData.AutoPriority.WorkSettings.Label: Settings by Work Type
LanguageData.AutoPriority.NeedGame: Need to be in a game to access settings, since they are on a per-game basis
LanguageData.AutoPriority.NoWorkTypes: No visible work types were loaded.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.ManageWorkType.Desc: When enabled, this mod controls this work type for every eligible colonist on each map. Other work types are left untouched.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.NumPawns.Desc: The normal number of top-ranked colonists assigned to this work type. Circumstances can temporarily add more.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.RankPriorities.Desc: The best candidate is colonist #1. Priority 1 is highest and priority 4 is lowest.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.CalculationFactors.Desc: Every eligible colonist is compared on these final in-game values. Final stats already include skills, health capacities, genes, equipment, and other modifiers.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstances.Desc: An active rule temporarily adds workers and raises their priority. If several rules are active, the strongest boost is used.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.NoRanking: Apply the settings to calculate a current ranking.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Medical.Desc: Active while a colonist or colony prisoner has a condition needing treatment.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Fire.Desc: Active while at least one fire exists on the map.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Food.Desc: Active when stored human-edible nutrition is below roughly two days per colonist.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Medicine.Desc: Active when fewer than one unit of medicine per colonist is available.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Prisoners.Desc: Active while the map contains colony prisoners.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Construction.D: Active when at least five blueprints or unfinished frames exist.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Hauling.Desc: Active when at least ten things have been manually designated for hauling.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Cleaning.Desc: Active when at least fifty pieces of filth exist on the map.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Plants.Desc: Active when at least ten plants are designated for cutting or harvesting.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Animals.Desc: Active while animals are designated for taming or slaughter.
LanguageData.AutoPriority.Circumstance.Hunting.Desc: Active when at least three animals are designated for hunting.
